payload.label: Analyze photos and videos
payload.description: Derives claims, embeddings, chapters, thumbnails, and evidence records from stored media through a package-owned command-output-to-records script and the shared command-run capability.

payload.message: Runtime proof remains blocked until CPD-10F source fingerprint and accepted-state no-op closure is recorded for media-analysis-content-media-evidence.

source_contract.media_type_contract: optional self-describing string supplied by source evidence

options_contract.analysis_command: optional object with process_descriptor and process_profile for the media analysis command to run through compute.process
options_contract.process_profile: open data for provider, model, credential handle refs, runtime, lanes, and output policy; lane/provider/model choices are not code branches

payload.authority_boundary: Per-source media evidence only. Cross-asset identity belongs to media-identity; pose/phase/alignment comparison belongs to motion-analysis.

payload.modality_contract: self-describing string supplied by evidence role/configuration
payload.vector_contract: Vector payloads live in vector_artifact_ref, not inline package records.

payload.thumbnail_contract: Thumbnail bytes live in artifact_ref, not inline package records.

payload.details_contract: optional machine-readable command/process details; never stores fabricated media claims

payload.name: write-media-analysis-record-from-command-run
payload.description: Write one canonical media-analysis record emitted by the command run.

payload.name: submit-media-analysis-request
payload.description: Write the canonical request, ask compute.process to run the configured media analysis command descriptor directly, make package records from its declared JSON output, and write accepted evidence/error records.

output_contract.first_declared_output: application/json command output consumed by the package record-making script

payload.name: media-resolve
payload.description: Turn a media request (description + kind + constraints) into a file via the data-selected provider table (media-resolve-providers.json). Providers are rows; the resolver has no provider branch.

payload.name: run-extraction-job
payload.description: Dispatch ONE extraction-job descriptor: read the extraction-job-descriptor record named by job_id and execute its declared workflow action with the artifact input. Blind: which action runs is DATA on the descriptor.

payload.name: run-corpus-extraction
payload.description: Read the named search-corpus descriptor, run each of its extraction_jobs job-actions over the given artifact, then fold the semantic index-content dispatch into this same run (P->Q in one action; label-hash update deltas do not refire triggers).

payload._basis: Matches the unified record-action-projection.record kind written by record-audio, record-video, and screen-recording via the save-recorded-file action, which carries recorded_file_id, recorded_at, artifact_ref (with .multihash), source_ref, recording_id, and capture_mode. Repointed 2026-08-14 from the retired legacy recorded-file kind (the former combined audio-plus-video capture package was split into record-audio + record-video).

Initial-write lane only for OTHER producers (e.g. audio-transcription.result); extraction->index for our own runs is folded into action:run-corpus-extraction because label-hash update deltas do not refire triggers.

Auto-index NEW media-analysis.embedding records (which self-describe an index-ready content_vector_base64, L090) into the media-visual semantic index. Initial-write lane; provenance model fields are DATA on this rule, matched to the media-visual descriptor.

Matches the REAL, already-wired generic kind content-media.relation.record (owned by content-media-evidence, action:content-media-evidence:create-relation) rather than a fabricated evidence kind. source_ref/target_ref/role_ref are opaque caller-supplied objects per content-media-evidence/things-to-store-and-run.json create-relation step (lines 213-350). context_ref is the one opaque object in the relation schema meant to carry extra caller data, and submit-media-analysis-request's input_schema (media-analysis workflow-action, this file) requires exactly {source, lanes, options, requested_at} supplied wholesale by the caller at request time. Producer contract: whoever creates the pending-media-analysis relation must populate context_ref = {source, lanes, options, requested_at} matching submit-media-analysis-request's input shape.

payload.name: search-media
payload.description: Two-lane search entry: dispatch the semantic lane (find-similar) and write each scored result as a search-result record so any blind record surface renders it. The exact-match lane is surface-side (search-index filters within loaded results).

payload.name: write-search-result
payload.description: Write ONE scored search hit as a published record (blind row for any record surface).
